nom: CeraVe Am Facial Moisturizing Lotion SPF 30

avis.titre: This sunscreen has given me a glass skin face
avis.texte: I bought this item due to the reviews I read about it on Amazon and I am so glad I believed in the reviews and made the purchase. This product is out of this world. It has helped my face immensely to the extent that many people wonder how I manage to remain young looking at 65 years. I have bought three more after my first purchase. It is a great product and not expensive. Thanks to the manufacturers and to Amazon for recommending it. I encourage many with sensitive face to try this product.

avis.titre: A great moisturizer with broad Spectrum coverage
avis.texte: This moisturizer is light, while providing broad spectrum sun protection. I use it daily and have great skin!

avis.titre: Highly rated by dermatologists, low cost
avis.texte: This product is a dual purpose moisturizer and sunscreen. Every woman should put on sun screen every morning and this makes it easy. Not greasy, no scent. As effective as much more expensive products.

avis.titre: Just what i was looking for
avis.texte: I was looking for a light suncream and this works perfectly. I wear it every day and it feels so light and not oily at all. Also it doubles as a moisturiser with hylauronic acid it's just perfect for the morning.

avis.titre: Light weight daily lotion for the face with SPF30
avis.texte: Like the light weight of this daily lotion with SPF 30. Also, it has a reasonably favorably rating by EWG, which means fewer harmful substances.

avis.titre: My dermatologist told me to use this
avis.texte: This has just enough moisturizer and sunscreen for my face. It lasts most of the day. It's reasonably priced and recommended by my dermatologist. It absorbs quickly.
I have used only Cerave lotion and cream for several years at the suggestion of my dermatologist and I will never use anything else. My husband says I look younger than my years 👌😊

avis.titre: Buen tiempo de entrega y buen producto.
avis.texte: Venía bien embalado, buen producto, buen precio y llegó rápido.
